description: The figure is a horizontal stacked bar chart illustrating the percentage agreement (“evaluation matches”) between an LLM judge and human annotations across 300 samples for six evaluation aspects. The category axis is the vertical (y) axis, listing the aspects in the displayed top-to-bottom order: “No Hallucination,” “Oriented,” “Active,” “Self-aware,” “Rigorous,” and “Correct.” The value axis is the horizontal (x) axis, labeled in percentages with a linear scale ranging from 0% to 100%, and tick marks shown at regular 20% intervals (0%, 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100%). Each category is represented by a single horizontal bar stacked into two components according to the legend: “Matched” in a darker blue and “Not Matched” in a lighter blue, with the two segments summing to 100% for each row; the bars include printed percentage labels inside the segments. “No Hallucination” shows 98.33% Matched and 1.67% Not Matched; “Oriented” shows 97.33% Matched and 2.67% Not Matched; “Active” shows 97.00% Matched and 3.00% Not Matched; “Self-aware” shows 94.00% Matched and 6.00% Not Matched; “Rigorous” shows 95.33% Matched and 4.67% Not Matched; and “Correct” shows 99.00% Matched and 1.00% Not Matched. The categories are not visually sorted by magnitude and there are no additional emphasis marks (such as outlines or callouts) beyond the in-bar percentage annotations and the legend.
